## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...).
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behaviour.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry, if users would notice the change.
- [ ] No secrets, keys or private memory content.

## Usability

<!-- Delete this section if nothing a user or an agent sees changed. -->

- [ ] Checked against the matching guide in `docs/usability/` (tools, agent-facing text, first run, docs).
- [ ] Every tool, command, setting and port named in changed docs or agent text exists.
- [ ] A change to default agent instructions, the AGENTS template or an everyday tool description includes a before/after agent evaluation, or says why it is wording-only.
- [ ] New or changed tools are reachable by the clients that should use them, and their errors name the next step.
